messages:
alex: hitting flaky streaming on mobile VPNs. Chunks arrive out-of-order and the client SSE parser emits duplicate events or hangs waiting for final blank line.

priya: which sdk? any repro?

alex: node sampleapp used to repro but mobile client repros with our browser sdk in a headless chrome on slow network throttle. sdk v0.9.4. logs show fragments like: `data: {"choices":[{"delta":"hel"}]}` then later `data: {"choices":[{"delta":"lo"}]}` but sometimes LB reorders these.

tom: if proxy reorders TCP segments (or we see splicing) our parser must be order-agnostic as long as the final event can be reconstructed. Are we treating each `data:` block as a full event?

priya: current parser assumes chunks map cleanly to events and uses `\n\n` boundaries. Need to change to stream-assembly: concatenate fragments until a full event seen, but also handle duplicates if router repeats bytes. Also add idempotency check by event-id if provided.

alex: mobile repro also shows long idle gaps where a partial event sits for seconds; UI times out. Could add idle-flush config (emit partial after X ms) and let app decide to continue.

tom: plan: 1) make parser accumulate partial lines instead of treating each chunk as event; 2) on socket close or stream end flush buffer; 3) configurable idle-flush default 750ms; 4) drop obvious duplicate events by content-hash or event-id.

priya: add unit tests simulating chunk reordering, duplication, and idle gaps for node/browser/python. Add an integ using mitmproxy to reorder/chop chunks.

alex: also add sampleapp flag `--simulate-reorder` so new devs can hit it locally. Saves support tickets.

devx-bot: CI kicked off for branch fix/sse-robust-assemble.

priya: will draft change and short README note on proxies and mobile VPNs. We'll ship in next minor release and patch sampleapp docs.

alex: thanks folks, will update issue with repro script and network traces.

devx-bot: merged after green tests. Release note: "SDKs: improved SSE assembly to handle chunk reordering and duplication; configurable idle-flush (default 750ms); sampleapp includes reorder sim flag."
